tier1.text: Dendrites receive signals from other neurons, or nerve cells, at contact points called synapses. Dendrites extend from the cell body, the main part of a neuron. Dendrites are usually short and branched, which gives them more surface area for receiving signals. From the dendrites, signals travel on to the cell body.

sentences.text: Dendrites receive signals from other neurons, or nerve cells, at contact points called synapses.

quotes.quote: The other processes of the neuron are dendrites, which receive information from other neurons at specialized areas of contact called synapses.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: The cells in nervous tissue that generate and conduct impulses are called neurons or nerve cells.
quotes.citation: SEER Training Modules: Nervous Tissue. U.S. National Institutes of Health, National Cancer Institute.

sentences.text: Dendrites extend from the cell body, the main part of a neuron.

quotes.quote: dendrite: one of many branchlike processes that extends from the neuron cell body and functions as a contact for incoming signals (synapses) from other neurons or sensory cells
quotes.section: Chapter 12 Key Terms (The Nervous System and Nervous Tissue)
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: the main part of a neuron is the cell body, which is also known as the soma (soma = “body”).
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Dendrites are usually short and branched, which gives them more surface area for receiving signals.

quotes.quote: Dendrites are usually, but not always, short and branching, which increases their surface area to receive signals from other neurons.
quotes.citation: SEER Training Modules: Nerve Tissue. U.S. National Institutes of Health, National Cancer Institute.

sentences.text: From the dendrites, signals travel on to the cell body.

quotes.quote: Once a signal is received by the dendrite, it then travels passively to the cell body.
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.
